newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Capel cuts UK spirits estimates.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Capel cuts UK spirits estimates.

text.p: Earnings estimates for UK spirits companies Guinness Plc, Grand Metropolitan Plc and Allied Domecq Plc were cut at HSBC James Capel, market sources said on Thursday.
For Guinness, Capel cut its 1997 pre-tax profit estimate by 45 million stg to 945 million and lowered its 1998 estimate by a similar level to 1,000 million stg, sources said.
For Grand Met, Capel cut its 1997 estimate by 10 million stg to 1,000 million and its 1998 estimate by 50 million stg to 1,070 million for 1998.
For Allied Domecq, Capel cut its 1997 estimate by five million stg to 610 million and for 1998 by 10 million stg to 650 million.
The brokerage repeated its "in-line" rating on the sector, sources said. Analysts at Capel were not immdiately available for comment.
